description: Poll a job returned by a generation tool. Includes durable steps, progress, failure/retry state and the resulting work revision with a Studio link. include_preview returns saved HUD/map/building concept images (at most 4). Set preview_view to return one chosen view. Concepts are generated illustrations, not verified 3D renders. Success does not mean visual approval or promotion.
